question: Should experiment-gated Claw lifecycle ownership diagnostics become a core doctor surface as part of the open Claws RFC stack?
rationale: The RFC explicitly treats these implementation PRs as prototype evidence and reserves permanent compatibility and gate removal for maintainer acceptance, which patch-level correctness cannot decide.

options.title: Sponsor the core doctor surface
options.body: Accept core doctor ownership after the diagnostic becomes strictly read-only and receives inspectable current-head behavior proof.

options.title: Keep it as RFC prototype evidence
options.body: Pause this stacked PR until the RFC defines the permanent ownership and compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core doctor surface
recommendation.body: Accept core doctor ownership after the diagnostic becomes strictly read-only and receives inspectable current-head behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared-state introduction, doctor migration history, and current review context make this person the strongest available owner for the core ownership decision.
